pr_body:
- Fixes: https://github.com/moby/moby/issues/45230


**- What I did**
Fix `Error response from daemon: repository name must be canonical` error when calling `docker image inspect` with a dangling image id (short or full digest).

**- How I did it**
Don't try to parse dangling images name (they have a non-canonical format - `moby-dangling@sha256:...`) as a reference. Log a warning if the image is not dangling and its name is not a valid named reference.

**- How to verify it**
```bash
$ docker images
REPOSITORY   TAG       IMAGE ID       CREATED              SIZE
busybox      latest    b5d6fe071263   About a minute ago   2.01MB
<none>       <none>    124c7d270790   18 seconds ago       3.27MB

$ docker inspect 124c7d270790 -f '{{.ID}}'
sha256:124c7d2707904eea7431fffe91522a01e5a861a624ee31d03372cc1d138a3126

$docker inspect 124c7d -f '{{.ID}}'
sha256:124c7d2707904eea7431fffe91522a01e5a861a624ee31d03372cc1d138a3126

$ docker inspect sha256:124c7d2707904eea7431fffe91522a01e5a861a624ee31d03372cc1d138a3126 -f '{{.ID}}'
sha256:124c7d2707904eea7431fffe91522a01e5a861a624ee31d03372cc1d138a3126

$ docker inspect 124c7d2707904eea7431fffe91522a01e5a861a624ee31d03372cc1d138a3126 -f '{{.ID}}'
sha256:124c7d2707904eea7431fffe91522a01e5a861a624ee31d03372cc1d138a3126

```

issue_context.title: `inspect` on dangling image doesn't work
issue_context.body:
### Description

Reported by @tianon

Inspecting a dangling image doesn't work with containerd integration.


### Reason
Inspect doesn't explicitly check if image is dangling at tries to parse its reference (which is a special, non-canonical `moby-dangling@sha256:...` format).
https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/d0f6fa036b91a2e0776eae2bd2e2908488530d7d/daemon/containerd/image.go#L102-L111



### Reproduce

```bash
$ docker images
REPOSITORY                       TAG       IMAGE ID       CREATED          SIZE
<none>                           <none>    9a63cd0416de   16 minutes ago   27.3MB
ubuntu                           latest    67211c14fa74   20 hours ago     27.4MB

$ docker inspect 9a63cd0416de # dangling
[]
Error response from daemon: repository name must be canonical

$ docker inspect 67211c14fa74 | head -n3 # ubuntu
[
    {
        "Id": "sha256:ca620b6a713882989f2dfb31dd34705834c95bc23e493687828080f6e5ad1be6",
```

### Expected behavior

The following commands should work:
```
$ docker inspect 9a63cd0416de
$ docker inspect 9a63cd0416de5b57259fa340d1
$ docker inspect sha256:sha256:9a63cd0416de5b57259fa340d1b8aff476065c4ab5f626232370504124e222c3
```

### docker version

```bash
master - d0f6fa036b91a2e0776eae2bd2e2908488530d7d
```


### docker info

```bash
containerd integration
```


### Additional Info

_No response_

review_comments: Doesn't this line only run if `tagged` is non-empty since it's inside a loop that's looping over `tagged`'s entries? :sweat_smile:
(what I mean is that this `if`'s condition will always be true)

It won't be true if tagged has only one element (which we are currently iterating) AND it's dangling.

If any image from tagged has the dangling name AND tagged is more than 1 element, then it means that the image itself is not dangling and there shouldn't be any image with the special dangling name.

https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/d0f6fa036b91a2e0776eae2bd2e2908488530d7d/daemon/containerd/image_list.go#L177
We can't pass the "bad" name here, because `References` is a `[]reference.Named` instead of `[]string` like in List...

Related discussion on `RepoTags` in list: https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/44840#discussion_r1084088210

IMO the inconsistency is worse than not showing the bad name in RepoTags, so maybe we should change the List behavior to match this?
